name: Sea Conditions
description: Hear the waves, swell, sea temperature and the tide (rising or falling, the next high and low tide) for a beach or port, and see the next days and tides. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a beach or port you choose in Preferences, Sea Conditions. Sea data by Open-Meteo.com (no account or API key needed).
author: Rafli
